The printed R-check satisfies (R-q)(R+q^{-1}) = 0 (middle block has trace q-q^{-1} and determinant -1). Schur-Weyl dimensions 4*1 + 2*2 = 8 correct. PRESENTATION GAP: Step 2 as displayed BACK-SOLVES y_{(2,1)}(q=1) = 1/4 from the closed form's known h^4 coefficient -3/4, then Combining Steps 1 and 2 presents (-3)*(1/4) = -3/4 as the derivation -- circular as written.
